OASIS_OS

build passingcoverage 78%license MIT

An embeddable operating system framework written in Rust (edition 2024). Provides a skinnable shell, scene-graph UI, virtual file system, and a from-scratch browser engine that renders HTML / CSS / Gemini to any pixel buffer.

Features

  • Runs on desktop (SDL3), WebAssembly, Unreal Engine 5, and Sony PSP hardware.
  • 18 skins including PSP XMB, Windows XP, NeXTSTEP, and BeOS.
  • 90+ terminal commands across 17 modules with shell expansion and pipes.
  • Full HTML5 tree construction with adoption agency and foster parenting.

Getting started

Clone the repository and run cargo build --release -p oasis-app. You will need Rust 1.91.0 or newer.

git clone https://github.com/altimit/oasis-os.git
cd oasis-os
cargo build --release
./target/release/oasis-app

Supported backends

The same core compiles to every backend. Each backend implements the SdiCore trait and optionally extends it with SdiBackend for accelerated primitives.
